Pose - Victory.name: Pose - Victory
Pose - Victory.description:
🕴️ Pose: Victory
A triumphant pose — fist raised, arms wide, or another gesture celebrating a win or achievement.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Pose - Victory.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Within the selected Portrait Framing, open the posture in celebration with the chest lifted and one or both frame-visible arms raised. Keep the complete gesture inside the crop and do not force hidden limbs into view. Female: the chest lifts and the arms go high and light. Male: chest and arms open together, shoulders squared. Otherwise (a Mutant body plan): the character's own celebration.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
